checks.label: Isolated records
checks.detail: Generated only in a disposable test database; existing application data is untouched.

checks.label: All provider combinations
checks.detail: CHW, Data Clerk and HCP in Iringa and Njombe; Services and Payroll for each.

checks.label: Real approval APIs exercised
checks.detail: CTC, version-bound OTP, HCP facility endorsement, technical, RPM, Finance review and explicit payor routing.

checks.label: All payment routes
checks.detail: Services/FHI360, direct CSO payroll, legacy Route B handoff and community Route C are kept distinct.

checks.label: Payment controls
checks.detail: Partial payment is not paid; full payment needs evidence and explicit confirmation; reconciliation uses a different person.

checks.label: Exceptions
checks.detail: Return/correction and insufficient-budget hold/reallocation/release both complete successfully.

checks.label: Exports and proof
checks.detail: CSV and XLSX exports were requested; the uploaded valid sample PDF states NOT PROOF OF A REAL PAYMENT.

checks.label: No real SMS or transfers
checks.detail: Mock SMS exists only inside generation. Production SMS configuration and account permissions are not changed.

scenarios.title: Iringa · CHW · Services
scenarios.description: New-record workflow. Recorded rates are fixed; RPM approves work, Regional Finance reviews and routes, and the payor records an external payment. All SMS, payment references and proof files in this replay are simulated.

steps.title: Provider records the work
steps.explanation: The provider records the activity, hours and aggregate counts, then attests.
steps.expected: DRAFT; no claim, budget commitment or payment exists.

steps.title: CTC verification
steps.explanation: The facility/CTC reviewer cross-checks all entries and monthly totals.
steps.expected: Only the assigned facility reviewer can verify this work.

steps.title: Provider SMS confirmation
steps.explanation: In this isolated test only, the mock gateway supplies the one-time code. No code is stored in this demo replay.
steps.expected: The confirmation applies to the exact CTC-verified version; no real SMS is sent.

steps.title: Cadre-specific technical review
steps.explanation: The CHW technical reviewer sees only their assigned cadres and regions.
steps.expected: Technical approval confirms the work, not a payment.

steps.title: RPM operational approval
steps.explanation: RPM authority covers every cadre in the assigned region. The RPM cannot channel or pay.
steps.expected: Approval atomically creates the priced claim from recorded activity rates.

steps.title: Claim automatically prepared
steps.explanation: Finance receives the same liability created by RPM; it has no category, payor or budget commitment yet.
steps.expected: PENDING_FINANCE_REVIEW; not batchable or payable.

steps.title: Explicit payor selection
steps.explanation: Finance selects FHI360 for Services, or the provider's assigned CSO for Payroll. Another payor is not eligible.
steps.expected: PENDING_ROUTING; finance review alone does not commit budget or mark paid.

steps.title: Payor receives routed claim
steps.explanation: Routing commits the budget and makes the claim READY. It does not transfer money.
steps.expected: Services go to FHI360; new Payroll goes directly to its CSO, without the legacy FHI360 handoff.

steps.title: Payment batch exported
steps.explanation: The immutable register is sent to the payor for external execution. Both export formats were checked.
steps.expected: EXPORTED is not PAID. No bank or wallet integration is invoked.

steps.title: Partial external payment recorded
steps.explanation: This is an explicitly simulated external-payment record, not an initiated transfer.
steps.expected: PARTIALLY_RECORDED; the log must not be shown as paid.

steps.title: Payment awaiting evidence
steps.explanation: The full amount is recorded, but evidence is mandatory.
steps.expected: PROOF_REQUIRED; full recorded amount alone is not enough.

steps.title: Sample proof uploaded
steps.explanation: The valid sample PDF is prominently marked NOT PROOF OF A REAL PAYMENT.
steps.expected: Uploading evidence alone does not change PROOF_REQUIRED to PAID.

steps.title: Payment confirmed
steps.explanation: The recorded amount and required evidence now both exist.
steps.expected: Claim payment status and provider work-log status are PAID.

steps.title: Independent reconciliation
steps.explanation: A different finance user reconciles the record. The payment recorder cannot reconcile their own payment.
steps.expected: RECONCILED; all earlier actors and decisions remain in the claim audit.

steps.title: Provider sees completed payment
steps.explanation: The provider can see their own completed work and claim, without finance-only proof or payment controls.
steps.expected: PAID work log and RECONCILED claim; no live financial records were changed.

steps.expected: PENDING_ROUTING; finance review alone does not commit budget or mark paid.

steps.title: Payor receives routed claim
steps.explanation: Routing commits the budget and makes the claim READY. It does not transfer money.
steps.expected: Services go to FHI360; new Payroll goes directly to its CSO, without the legacy FHI360 handoff.

steps.title: Payment batch exported
steps.explanation: The immutable register is sent to the payor for external execution. Both export formats were checked.
steps.expected: EXPORTED is not PAID. No bank or wallet integration is invoked.

steps.title: Partial external payment recorded
steps.explanation: This is an explicitly simulated external-payment record, not an initiated transfer.
steps.expected: PARTIALLY_RECORDED; the log must not be shown as paid.

steps.title: Payment awaiting evidence
steps.explanation: The full amount is recorded, but evidence is mandatory.
steps.expected: PROOF_REQUIRED; full recorded amount alone is not enough.

steps.title: Sample proof uploaded
steps.explanation: The valid sample PDF is prominently marked NOT PROOF OF A REAL PAYMENT.
steps.expected: Uploading evidence alone does not change PROOF_REQUIRED to PAID.

steps.title: Payment confirmed
steps.explanation: The recorded amount and required evidence now both exist.
steps.expected: Claim payment status and provider work-log status are PAID.

steps.title: Independent reconciliation
steps.explanation: A different finance user reconciles the record. The payment recorder cannot reconcile their own payment.
steps.expected: RECONCILED; all earlier actors and decisions remain in the claim audit.

steps.title: Provider sees completed payment
steps.explanation: The provider can see their own completed work and claim, without finance-only proof or payment controls.
steps.expected: PAID work log and RECONCILED claim; no live financial records were changed.

scenarios.title: Legacy Route B
scenarios.description: Preserved legacy workflow, not the default for new records. FHI360 batches and hands payroll to the assigned CSO.

steps.title: Legacy claim prepared
steps.explanation: The approved work or verified community evidence is priced using the preserved legacy rules.
steps.expected: Legacy claims follow their original approval family; new records cannot opt into this path.

steps.title: Independent claim approval
steps.explanation: A second person approves the claim. The preparer cannot approve their own claim.
steps.expected: Budget is committed only after independent approval succeeds.

steps.title: Legacy claim ready
steps.explanation: Ready is not paid. Export is an auditable, separate step.
steps.expected: READY, with no payment transfer.

steps.title: Legacy batch exported
steps.explanation: Both CSV and XLSX exports contain the simulated register.
steps.expected: EXPORTED does not mean money was sent.

steps.title: FHI360 hands off to CSO
steps.explanation: This handoff belongs only to legacy Route B, not new payroll.
steps.expected: The assigned CSO must acknowledge before recording payment.

steps.title: Legacy payment needs proof
steps.explanation: An external payment record exists, but required evidence is still missing.
steps.expected: PROOF_REQUIRED; no real transfer occurred.

steps.title: Legacy payment confirmed
steps.explanation: Required simulated payment evidence and full amount are present.
steps.expected: PAID; the historical workflow remains distinct from new records.

steps.title: Legacy record reconciled
steps.explanation: A person other than the recorder reconciles the simulated record.
steps.expected: RECONCILED; immutable claim history is retained.
